exact_statement: There exists K_PAC in N such that for every k >= K_PAC there exists a finite N_k with Pr[pi_k in Pi_opt^(epsilon_k)] >= 1-delta_k.
assumptions: finite MDP and finite action set
positive minimum nonzero transition probability p_min
the conservative two-sided PAC-BVI transition bounds and EC-collapse guarantee apply
pass_condition: The reconstructed quantifier proof closes, exact binary search finds and brackets finite minimum N values without using a theorem formula, the independent adaptive checker agrees, and N-1 and zero-exploration controls are rejected.
fail_condition: A quantified witness need not exist under the assumptions, an independent tail check disagrees, or a negative control passes.
